notes.title: Invector: Rhythm Galaxy | Console Release
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=tSGMVwrQewM;full][/previewyoutube]
Finally, the day has come to let console in on the fun and enjoy Invector: Rhythm Galaxy. The sequel to the much beloved Avicii Invector is now released globally on consoles, and we are thrilled as a team to see where the future might take us.

Forty songs from some of today’s biggest artists are blended with stunning visuals for you to enjoy on your own or with friends. Available today on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and, of course, Steam.

With lots of love from all of us at Hello There Games <3

notes.title: The input update
notes.notes:
A new update is available!

We have added controller remapping, controller specific settings and a new Input calibration screen.
We have also reset the leaderboards so let the climbing begin!

ːaviciiː ːaviciiː ːaviciiː

Change log
[list]
[*] Controller remapping
[*] New input calibration, (No visual cues, you should just listen and tap)
[*] Input related settings are saved per device so you can have different settings among players when playing multiplayer. (there is always one person wants to invert the y axis :wink:
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Timing windows adjusted to be more forgiving to compensate for inaccurate input timing on some systems
[/list]

notes.title: The input update
notes.notes:
New patch out on the beta track!!! 

You can access the beta by right-clicking on AVICII Invector then select Betas from the menu and choose "Beta - Public testing". 

We will let this test run over the weekend and if nothing severe is reported the patch will be live on Monday next week together with a leaderboard reset. That way we have some time to archive the old leaderboards for safekeeping.

Change log
[list]
[*] Controller remapping
[*] New input calibration
[*] Input related settings are saved per device so you can have different settings among players when playing multiplayer. (there is always one person wants to invert the y axis ;)
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Timing windows adjusted to be more forgiving to compensate for inaccurate input timing on some systems
[/list]

Get ready to climb the ladders next week!

notes.title: New patch incoming - resetting highscores
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope that you are well and staying safe. We have a new patch coming for Steam with some hotfixes and the ability to remap controllers. At the same time, we will reset high scores as it has become bloated with incorrect entries. So if you want to stash away your high score entries for a trip down the memory lane - snap a few screenshots for safekeeping. The patch will be arriving on Friday, March 12th.

On a side note, how often would you like to see the high score reset? Please express your opinion through this poll
http://directpoll.com/v?XDVhEtvC48KFoQpDqcJs5ToFuMAdMZ

notes.title: An Update reference our Avicii Switch Lite Charity Raffle
notes.notes:
Hey there folks - hope your Friday is treating you all with kindness!

Just wanted to give everyone a quick update reference the charity Ebay auction for the 5th Avicii Switch Lite.

If you bought a raffle ticket (thank you!!) you will have received an email from ebay this morning stating the auction had been removed.

Long story short - our auction was suspended:

Despite working directly with eBay, a separate team, unaware, ended the auction. They have apologised but it is irreversible.

Safe In Our World is going to refund ALL donations. As a small charity with no grants, it is a bit of a pain, but the right thing to do.

In the meantime please sit tight and await your refund - and we are currently setting up a new home to hold the auction.

We will share more soon - thank you for your patience! 💕

notes.title: The smooth update
notes.notes:
We have worked hard to make Avicii Invector a faster, smoother and better experience.

Changes and bug fixes: 
[list]
[*] Fixed many of the crash bugs.
[*] Refactored the input system to fix the button prompts. Now correct buttons are displayed for your controller type.
[*] Massive optimizations, making the game run better and have shorter loading pauses.
[*] Smoother menu flow.
[*] Added Turkish localization
[/list]

Please let us know in the steam forums if there's any issues found in this update, its a major one in many ways.

More news coming soon from us at Hello There and Wired Productions!

notes.title: The Danish Update
notes.notes:
This update brings you:

Localization:
Added Danish (Translation by Mathias Thulin)

Bug fixes:
Fixed a few missing strings in various languages.
Fix for missing badges in song select
Fix leader board bug, where you always placed 10th even if you did not make it to top 10
Fix flashing triangle tunnel
Optimizations in Valley

Changes:
Changed how % is displayed. Previously the % updated for every successful and missed pickup. Now it starts at 100% and only goes down for missed pickups.
